module_v2.rule: copy of metrics_v1 (unchanged files byte-identical, checked by the tests); changed: band.py (+ slope-adjusted band), stats.py (+ bias / dispersion split); new: regions.py (MVS-at-GT split), bins.py (merging of small size bins, correction boundary)
module_v2.why: the trial numbers stay reproducible with metrics_v1

regions_v2.mvs_at_gt: per site: the COLMAP geometric depth maps of the box MVS (/prep/mvs/box_<site>, confidence 1 = valid geometric depth) back-projected with the stage-1 camera convention; z_MVS at a GT point = median of the MVS points in its 0.1 m cell, >= 3 points (the trial's proxy_check / path 5 reading)
regions_v2.gt_points_of_a_patch: the ownership rows of the patch's label source (B0 sites: gt_clean labels -> gt_owner_<prior> on gt_primary.npz, ULS labels -> gt_owner_uls_<prior> on gt_points.npz; other sites: gt_owner_<prior> on gt_points.npz)
regions_v2.patch_value: d = median over the patch's GT points with an MVS value of (z_MVS - z_GT); |MVS - GT| = |d|
regions_v2.split: roof-like patches with v1 code 2 or 3 -> 2 when |d| <= tau else 3; with v1 code 11 or 12 -> 11 when |d| <= tau else 12 (the same implementation for both boundaries)
regions_v2.kept_v1: patches with fewer than 5 GT points with an MVS value and every wall-like patch keep their v1 code; flagged in the array v1_kept
regions_v2.outputs: regions_v2/regions_ext_v2_<site>_<prior>.npz (v1 arrays + code_ext_v2, mvs_minus_gt_at_gt, n_mvs_at_gt, v1_kept; gt_suspect added by 4.5), a table of the patches and area that moved per code (site x prior), maps with the moved patches outlined
regions_v2.why: order 4.2; the trial's proxy_check showed that the per-patch residual median misreads large offsets (86 % of the B173 wing 'both wrong' patches are within tau at the GT points)

edge_band_v2.rule: a roof point is in the band when (range of the GT heights within r = 0.5 m) - 2 r tan(theta) > 0.3 m, theta = the slope of the owning patch's prior face (patch normal), capped at 80 degrees
edge_band_v2.raster: the trial's 0.1 m raster of the per-cell max / min GT z with a disk filter (unchanged)
edge_band_v2.why: order 4.3; on a plane of slope theta the range within r is about 2 r tan(theta), which the trial band counted as an edge

height_range.rule: support-agreement roof points outside the band: faces of slope <= 17 degrees -> vertical height difference (highest crossing of the vertical line, as the trial); faces steeper than 17 degrees -> signed distance along the prior-face normal (nearest crossing within 2 m); band points and wall points -> signed distance along the prior-face normal (as the trial)
height_range.why: order 4.3; at slope theta the vertical difference is 1 / cos(theta) times the normal distance (1.15 at 30, 1.41 at 45 degrees)

accuracy_v2.classes: gentle roof (<= 17 degrees, vertical), steep roof (> 17 degrees, normal), roof outside the band (both), band (normal), wall (normal)
accuracy_v2.bias: signed median of the height difference (or normal distance)
accuracy_v2.dispersion: NMAD (1.4826 x median |d - median|), median |d - median|, 68.3 % and 95 % quantiles of |d - median|
accuracy_v2.also: removed share by slope; remaining points per building (B173 recovery)
accuracy_v2.results: the four trainings and the four prior-as-is results (surface, same path)

observation_error_check.sites: the four sites; training-result sections only at B173nb_b10
observation_error_check.overlay: region v2 patches (roof-like, centres projected; visible = the first crossing of the camera ray with the registered prior lies within 0.3 m of the patch centre) drawn on: B173nb_b10 the two nadir evaluation views of the stage-0 figures (DJI_20241217091245_0145_D, DJI_20241217091127_0106_D); the other sites one nadir training view each = the box training view with tilt <= 20 degrees whose projection of the centroid of the site's roof-like region patches lies nearest the image centre; colours: observation error (3), support agreement (2), GT missing (0)
observation_error_check.gt_appearance: per site x prior, observation error (3) vs support agreement (2), roof-like: per 0.25 m cell of the patches' footprint (cells holding a patch centre) the GT point count; the share of cells whose GT height range exceeds 0.3 m (a double layer); the share of 0.5 m survey cells within 1 m of the patch centre that hold no GT point or are excluded; from the raw ULS laz (matched to the GT points by position, 0.5 mm): intensity, return number and number of returns distributions
observation_error_check.sections: B173nb_b10, LoD2 regions v2: the five observation-error roof-like patches owning the most GT points, each more than 2 m from the ones chosen before (greedy by GT point count); vertical section through the patch centre along the dip direction of the face (u axis when flatter than 5 degrees), 12 m long, points within 0.25 m of the plane: GT points, MVS points (box MVS back-projected), the registered LoD2 and ALS surfaces, the four training meshes; chosen from pre-training data before any training result of this task is read (written to defs/sections_obs.json)
observation_error_check.suspect_rule: proposed from the GT / MVS evidence above (pre-training data) and written to configs/phd/metrics_fix_v1/gt_suspect_rule_v1.json with its time and sha256 before its effect on the trainings is computed; stored as the array gt_suspect in the region v2 files; region codes unchanged; its effect (observation-error area, error inflow rate at B173nb_b10 with and without the flagged patches) reported, removal decided by the user

height_proportional.points: per building (LoD2 footprints of the site box): GT roof points (ULS gt_points of the site; ownership of the ULS label source) of roof-like patches that are support agreement (code 2, regions v2) under both priors, outside the band v2, prior-face slope <= 17 degrees; at least 500 points, else the building is listed but not fitted
height_proportional.offsets: median of z_MVS - z_GT (0.1 m cell median, the trial path 5), z_LoD2 - z_GT and z_ALS - z_GT (highest crossing of the registered prior surface, the trial path 3)
height_proportional.ground: GT points (in the evaluation range, not excluded) outside every footprint buffered by 1 m, inside the ring 2-20 m around the building's footprint, with z <= DTM + 0.3 m (survey DTM, 0.5 m cells); height above ground = median roof z - median ground z of the ring; the ground offsets (MVS - GT, ALS - GT) per site as the height-0 reference
height_proportional.fit: per site and offset: ordinary least squares offset = a + b x height over the buildings plus the site's ground point (height 0; not for LoD2, which has no ground); slope b in per mille, a, 95 % intervals (t, n - 2 degrees of freedom; none when n <= 2); a pooled fit of the four sites recorded
height_proportional.image_sets: training views per site (fork_inputs split.json) and their overlaps; all sites share one SfM (937 posed images)
height_proportional.no_fix: only listed: ways to correct (image-side height scale, GT re-alignment, ...) and what each would make re-run

virtual_view_test.aim: the main unseen wall ext 53 (18,298 of the 18,747 unseen patches): centre (153.56, 111.76, -33.79), outward normal (0.9308, -0.3655, 0), along-wall axis (0.3655, 0.9308), span -39.6..30.15 m
virtual_view_test.current: the trial's 16 views (r10 rule: rings of 8 at 124.3 m, elevations 0.2 / 0.5), all Gaussians (trial gpu/<run>/mesh_virtual.ply reused)

option1.rule: 10 views 25 m in front of the wall along its outward normal (order: 20-30 m), 5 positions along the wall 14 m apart centred on its span (along -32.73, -18.73, -4.73, 9.27, 23.27 m) x 2 heights: z -21.5 m (3 m above the highest GT point, 98th percentile, of the 20-30 m strip in front: -24.5) and z -14.0 m (steeper look); each looks at the wall's mid-height point (z -33.79) at its along position; intrinsics of the first training view; camera axes as the fork's helper (right = up x forward); all Gaussians
option1.why_only_ext53: the four small unseen faces (ext 58, 67, 76, 79; 341 patches) are corner pieces whose 25 m outward point lies over or inside B173

option2.rule: the trial's 16 views unchanged; every view (training and virtual) rendered with only the Gaussians whose centre lies inside the stage-0 TSDF box (x 76.34-182.66, y 56.31-175.49, z -49.03 - -0.86)

virtual_view_test.compare: per option and training: below-roof patch centres within 0.5 m (mesh-level inheritance), above-roof patch centres within 0.2 m (past shape), seed variation of both, share of mesh vertices around the walls within 0.2 m of the wall plane (the ALS blur), GPU seconds and host memory
virtual_view_test.choice_rule: written before the test: prefer the option with the largest LoD2 - ALS gap of the below-roof 0.5 m share (agreement with the Gaussian-level inheritance rate, 78-81 % vs 5 %) whose mean seed variation (both priors, both shares) is not larger than the current option's; ties broken by GPU time

accepted_proposals.1_error_inflow: the window t = min(0.5 m, |W - GT| / 2) unchanged; the main error inflow rate counts the points with |W - GT| >= 0.2 m; the indeterminable share (|W - GT| < 0.2 m) is written next to it
accepted_proposals.2_size_bins: bins [1, 1.5), [1.5, 2), [2, 3), [3, 4), [4, 8), 8+ (tau multiples) unchanged, with point and patch counts; a bin with fewer than 10,000 points (main points) is merged into the next larger bin, the last one into the previous (single site; decided per prior from pre-training point counts); the '< 1' bin reported apart; correction rate = GT-side share over the main points; correction boundary = lower edge of the first bin from which every larger bin has a correction rate >= 50 %
accepted_proposals.3_past_shape: past-shape persistence rate only for patches whose W lies more than 0.5 m from the GT (|patch value| > 0.5 m); in the observation-error region the Gaussians of any origin are counted
accepted_proposals.4_floating: floating Gaussians reported as 3-20 m and above 20 m over the highest GT surface; 3-20 m read with the past-shape persistence rate
accepted_proposals.5_unmeasured: missing / invisible regions: within one site a record only (stage 1 reads them pooled over the sites)
accepted_proposals.6_invisible: invisible agreement / error split by the current-roof inferred label, written 'inferred'
accepted_proposals.7_virtual_mesh: virtual-view mesh at 0.10 m in the stage-1 post step, read with the inheritance rate; views = the option chosen by 4.7

observation_error_W_v2.rule: for observation-error rows of roof-like patches split by v2: W at a GT point = z_MVS of its 0.1 m cell (vertical), else the patch value d; the patch's W centre = patch centre moved vertically by (gt_med + d); v1-kept patches keep the trial W (prior + MVS residual median)
observation_error_W_v2.why: the same MVS reading as the region boundary (order 4.2: one implementation for both boundaries)
